## SSH confirmation (live check, 2026-08-06)

| Path | Network | Auth |
|------|---------|------|
| Mac → `ubuntu@130.210.0.72` (micro1) | OK | OK (your ed25519) |
| Mac → `ubuntu@161.118.161.51` (micro2) | OK | OK (your ed25519) |

- temporarily allow s145’s egress IP for SSH, or
